insight.headline: GraphQL Admin API Error
insight.what_changed: The GraphQL Admin API now returns an error when a query filters by a metafield that isn't set up for filtering. This change starts in API version 2026-10. Previously, the API would silently return incorrect results.
insight.developer_impact: Developers should update their GraphQL queries to handle the new error response. They should also review their metafield configurations to ensure they are set up correctly for filtering. The `metafield` object and its `key` and `value` fields are affected by this change. Developers can use the `metafield` object to retrieve metafield definitions and check if a metafield is set up for filtering.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants may notice more accurate results from GraphQL queries that filter by metafields. They may also receive more informative error messages if a query is invalid.
insight.why_it_matters: This change improves the accuracy and reliability of the GraphQL Admin API. It also helps developers catch and fix errors in their queries more easily.

updates.title: POS UI extensions can now print directly to hardware receipt printers
updates.summary: POS UI extensions can now print directly to hardware receipt printers using the Printing API (shopify.printing). This enables extensions to discover and send documents to connected receipt printers.

updates.title: Invalid metafield queries now return errors in the GraphQL Admin API
updates.summary: The GraphQL Admin API now returns errors for invalid metafield queries, starting in API version 2026-10, instead of silently returning incorrect results.

updates.title: Metafield triggers and additional topics are now available for Events
updates.summary: Metafield triggers and additional topics are now available for Events, allowing apps to subscribe to events for various resources and metafield changes.

updates.title: Liquid templates can now compose pages with blocks and partials
updates.summary: Liquid templates can now compose pages with blocks and partials, introducing a simpler way to build theme pages.

updates.title: Full-stack capabilities to power app analytics
updates.summary: Full-stack capabilities are now available to power app analytics, simplifying the process of building merchant-facing analytics.

updates.title: Physical inventory feature preview
updates.summary: The physical inventory feature preview introduces a new set of inventory APIs in the unstable version of the GraphQL Admin API.
CLI version 4.5.2 fixes a warning when running theme commands in valid theme directories and bumps Shopify/theme-tools packages.

updates.title: Card deposit endpoint now requires mTLS certificate
updates.summary: The card deposit endpoint now requires a Shopify-issued mTLS client certificate, affecting apps that store cardholder data.

recap.headline: Shopify updates enhance POS UI extensions and GraphQL Admin API

themes.title: POS UI Extensions
themes.detail: The Printing API (shopify.printing) is introduced in POS UI Extensions 2026-07, allowing extensions to discover and print directly to hardware receipt printers using getPrinters(). This update streamlines the printing process for merchants.

themes.title: GraphQL Admin API Improvements
themes.detail: Starting in API version 2026-10, the GraphQL Admin API will return errors when a query filters by a metafield that isn't set up for filtering, preventing silent incorrect results. This change enhances the accuracy and reliability of metafield queries.

actions.text: Review and update POS UI extensions to utilize the new Printing API
Test GraphQL Admin API queries for metafield filtering errors in preparation for API version 2026-10
